statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-13608 is a flaw in libcurl's SASL negotiation for LDAP authentication, in its OpenLDAP backend (lib/openldap.c): a man-in-the-middle can inject a premature response that libcurl accepts as a completed verification. It affects curl 7.82.0 through 8.21.0 built with LDAP support and is fixed in 8.22.0 (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-13608.html). DHI curl for Alpine 3.23 is built from Alpine's main/curl recipe (https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/3.23-stable/main/curl/APKBUILD) and each build carries the upstream curl release named by its version, as the libcurl/X.Y.Z version string in libcurl.so shows. That recipe configures curl with --disable-ldap. We checked every published build for Alpine 3.23 (8.17.0-r1 to the current 8.23.0-r1, x86_64 and aarch64): no libcurl.so links an LDAP library or imports any ldap_ or ber_ function, the debug information in curl-dbg contains none of the OpenLDAP backend's oldap_ functions, and the static libcurl.a in curl-static has no oldap_ symbol and no LDAP import. The LDAP code this CVE is in is not compiled into any build of this owner.
